simple.meaning: גְּזֵרָה (gᵉzêrâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a decree.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: גְּזֵרָה (H1510) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 4:14, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גְּזֵרָה (H1510) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in גְּזֵרָה (H1510) before moving outward to related references.
